text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flashing back to before the summer 
training camp—Cheval Grand shares a 
conversation with Shine Praise, who is 
preparing to depart for Australia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shine Praise promised to tackle new races 
in a new land and grow even stronger, 
vowing that they would face off again at 
the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—At last, the Senior Year summer training 
camp begins. With their sights set on 
facing their childhood friend in the Japan 
Cup, a summer of intense training gets 
underway!
